lessons.title: True, False or Not Given?
lessons.goal_uz: IELTS Reading'ning eng qiyin savol turini yechasiz: cheklovchi so'zlar (some, most, always, may) ma'noni qanday o'zgartirishini sezasiz.

words.ex: The writer claims that sleep improves memory.
The results contradict earlier studies.
There is no evidence for this theory.
Over two hundred participants took part.
Scores improved significantly.
Don't assume — check the text.
The course is exclusively online.
Prices rose slightly.

steps.title: Sleep and learning
steps.text: For decades, teachers have assumed that students who stay up late to revise perform better in exams. A recent study at a university in Finland suggests the opposite. Researchers followed 240 first-year students over one academic year. Participants who slept at least seven hours a night achieved significantly higher marks than those who regularly slept less than six. Interestingly, the effect was strongest in mathematics and slightly weaker in language subjects. The researchers do not claim that sleep alone guarantees success; students who slept well also tended to have more regular study habits. However, they argue that the common practice of sacrificing sleep before exams may do more harm than good.
steps.uz: O'n yillar davomida o'qituvchilar imtihonga kech yotib tayyorlanadigan talabalar yaxshiroq natija ko'rsatadi deb hisoblab kelgan. Finlandiyadagi universitetda o'tkazilgan yaqindagi tadqiqot buning aksini ko'rsatmoqda. Tadqiqotchilar bir o'quv yili davomida 240 nafar birinchi kurs talabasini kuzatdi. Kechasi kamida yetti soat uxlagan ishtirokchilar muntazam olti soatdan kam uxlaganlarga qaraganda sezilarli darajada yuqori baho oldi. Qizig'i shundaki, ta'sir matematikada eng kuchli, til fanlarida esa biroz zaifroq bo'ldi. Tadqiqotchilar faqat uyquning o'zi muvaffaqiyatni kafolatlaydi deb da'vo qilishmaydi; yaxshi uxlagan talabalarning o'qish odatlari ham ko'proq muntazam bo'lgan. Biroq ular imtihon oldidan uyquni qurbon qilish odati foydadan ko'ra ko'proq zarar keltirishi mumkinligini ta'kidlaydi.

steps.q: The study took place over one academic year.
steps.explain_uz: "over one academic year" — matn bilan aynan mos → **True**.

steps.q: The effect of sleep was strongest in language subjects.
steps.explain_uz: Matnda: eng kuchli — **matematikada**, tilda esa zaifroq. Matnga zid → **False**.

steps.title_uz: T / F / NG: cheklovchi so'zlarga e'tibor
steps.body_uz:
**True** — matn bir xil ma'noni aytadi (ko'pincha boshqa so'zlar bilan — parafraz).
**False** — matn **teskarisini** aytadi. Matnda zid dalil bor.
**Not Given** — matnda bu haqda **ma'lumot yo'q**: tasdiqlab ham, inkor qilib ham bo'lmaydi.
Eng ko'p tuzoq — **cheklovchi so'zlar**. Bitta so'z javobni o'zgartiradi:
**all / every** ≠ **most / many** ≠ **some** · **always** ≠ **often** ≠ **sometimes** · **will / proves** ≠ **may / suggests** · **only / exclusively** ≠ **mainly**
Matn: "Most students improved." Savol: "**All** students improved." → **False**.
Matn: "Sleep **may** help." Savol: "Sleep **guarantees** success." → **False** (yoki matnda inkor bo'lsa).
O'z bilimingizdan foydalanmang! Faqat matnda yozilganga tayaning.
False va Not Given farqi: "Matnda bunga **qarshi** gap bormi?" Bor → False. Yo'q → Not Given.

examples.en: Text: Many visitors come in summer. Statement: Most visitors come in summer. → Not Given
Text: The bridge was completed in 1998. Statement: The bridge was finished before 2000. → True
Text: The drug may reduce pain. Statement: The drug always reduces pain. → False
Text: The museum is open daily. Statement: The museum is free. → Not Given

steps.q: All the students in the study slept at least seven hours a night.
steps.explain_uz: Matnda olti soatdan kam uxlaganlar ham bor → **False**.

steps.q: The study was paid for by the Finnish government.
steps.explain_uz: Moliyalashtirish haqida hech narsa yo'q → **Not Given**.

steps.q: The researchers believe sleep alone guarantees success.
steps.explain_uz: "The researchers do not claim that sleep alone guarantees success" → **False**.

steps.q: Students who slept well tended to study more regularly.
steps.explain_uz: "also tended to have more regular study habits" → **True** (parafraz).

steps.q: Text: "Some experts disagree." Statement: "Experts all agree."

steps.text: If the text says nothing about the statement, the answer is ___ Given.
answer: Not
steps.uz: Matnda ma'lumot bo'lmasa, javob — Not Given.

steps.text: Text: "Prices rose slightly." Statement: "Prices rose dramatically." → ___
answer: False
steps.uz: slightly ≠ dramatically.
Matnda bu haqda hech qanday ma'lumot yo'q.
steps.answer: The text gives no information about this

steps.q: Statement: "The library is open every day." Is it True, False or Not Given?
steps.say: The library is open from Monday to Saturday, from nine in the morning until eight in the evening.

answer: The results contradict earlier studies.
The results contradict earlier studies
steps.uz: Eshiting va yozing
Tadqiqot uyqu xotirani yaxshilashi mumkinligini ko'rsatadi.
answer: The study suggests that sleep may improve memory
The study shows that sleep may improve memory
The research suggests that sleep may improve memory
The study suggests sleep may improve memory
The study shows that sleep can improve memory

steps.text: The researchers do not claim that sleep alone guarantees success.
steps.uz: Ovoz chiqarib ayting

steps.prompt_uz: Yuqoridagi matn asosida o'zingiz 4 ta T/F/NG gap tuzing (har biridan kamida bittadan) va har birining javobini matndan dalil bilan tushuntiring.
steps.prompt: Write four True/False/Not Given statements about the text and explain each answer with evidence from the text.
steps.example: 1. The researchers studied first-year students. — True, because the text says they followed 240 first-year students. 2. Teachers have always believed that sleep is more important than revision. — False, because the text says teachers assumed that staying up late to revise was better. 3. The students who slept less than six hours failed their exams. — Not Given, because the text only says their marks were lower, not that they failed. 4. Most of the students were studying mathematics. — Not Given, because the text does not say which subjects the students studied.

lessons.title: While it is true that...
lessons.title_uz: Writing: qarshi fikrni tan olib, rad etish
lessons.goal_uz: Inshoda qarshi fikrni tan olib (concession), keyin uni ishonarli rad etasiz — Task Response va Coherence uchun 7+ darajadagi uslub.

words.ex: Admittedly, the plan is expensive.
It was raining. Nevertheless, we went out.
The benefits outweigh the costs.
That is a valid point.
The main drawback is the cost.
The risks are often overstated.
There is compelling evidence for this.
Notwithstanding the cost, the project was approved.

steps.title: Model paragraph: should university be free?
steps.text: Opponents of free university education argue that it places an unfair burden on taxpayers, many of whom never attended university themselves. Admittedly, this is a valid concern: funding higher education for everyone would require significant public spending. Nevertheless, I would argue that the long-term benefits far outweigh this drawback. Graduates typically earn higher salaries and therefore pay considerably more in taxes over their lifetimes, which means that much of the initial investment is eventually returned. Moreover, a better-educated workforce attracts foreign investment and drives innovation, benefiting even those who did not study themselves. While it is true that free education is expensive in the short term, it is, in my view, one of the most effective investments a country can make.
steps.uz: Bepul oliy ta'limga qarshi chiquvchilar bu soliq to'lovchilarga — ularning ko'pchiligi o'zi universitetda o'qimagan — adolatsiz yuk bo'ladi, deb ta'kidlaydi. Tan olish kerakki, bu asosli xavotir: hamma uchun oliy ta'limni moliyalashtirish katta davlat xarajatlarini talab qiladi. Shunga qaramay, menimcha, uzoq muddatli foydalar bu kamchilikdan ancha ustun. Bitiruvchilar odatda ko'proq maosh oladi va shu sababli umr davomida ancha ko'p soliq to'laydi, demak dastlabki sarmoyaning katta qismi oxir-oqibat qaytadi. Bundan tashqari, yaxshi ta'lim olgan ishchi kuchi xorijiy sarmoyani jalb qiladi va innovatsiyani harakatlantiradi — bu hatto o'zi o'qimaganlarga ham foyda keltiradi. Bepul ta'lim qisqa muddatda qimmat ekani rost bo'lsa-da, menimcha, bu mamlakat qila oladigan eng samarali sarmoyalardan biridir.

steps.q: What is the writer's position?
options: The writer has no clear opinion.
steps.explain_uz: "the long-term benefits far outweigh this drawback" — yozuvchi bepul ta'lim tarafdori.

steps.q: Why does the writer mention the taxpayers' argument?
options: To acknowledge it and then argue against it
steps.explain_uz: Bu — **concession**: qarshi fikrni tan olib, keyin rad etish.

steps.title_uz: Concession + rebuttal — tan olish va rad etish
steps.body_uz:
7+ ball inshoda faqat o'z fikringizni emas, **qarshi fikrni ham ko'rib chiqasiz** va nega u kuchsizroq ekanini ko'rsatasiz.
Tuzilma: **1) qarshi fikr → 2) tan olish → 3) rad etish (o'z fikringiz + dalil)**.
**Bitta gap ichida** (+ vergul): **While / Although / Even though** it is true that X, Y. · **Despite / In spite of / Notwithstanding** + **ot / -ing**: Despite **the cost**... ("Despite it is expensive" — xato!)
**Ikki gap orqali**: **Admittedly, / It is true that / Granted,** X. **Nevertheless, / However, / Even so,** Y.
Rad etish iboralari: **the benefits outweigh the drawbacks** · **this argument overlooks the fact that...** · **this concern is somewhat overstated**.
Maslahat: qarshi fikrni hurmat bilan bering ("a valid concern") — bu yozuvchini ob'ektiv ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: While it is true that online learning is flexible, it cannot fully replace face-to-face interaction.
examples.uz: Onlayn ta'lim moslashuvchan ekani rost bo'lsa-da, u yuzma-yuz muloqotni to'liq almashtira olmaydi.

examples.en: Admittedly, nuclear power is risky. Nevertheless, it produces almost no carbon emissions.
examples.uz: Tan olish kerakki, atom energiyasi xavfli. Shunga qaramay, u deyarli karbonat chiqindisi chiqarmaydi.

examples.en: Despite the high initial cost, solar panels save money in the long run.
examples.uz: Dastlabki narxi baland bo'lishiga qaramay, quyosh panellari uzoq muddatda pul tejaydi.

examples.en: This argument, however, overlooks the fact that most crime is committed by repeat offenders.
examples.uz: Biroq bu dalil ko'p jinoyatlarni takroriy jinoyatchilar sodir etishini e'tiborsiz qoldiradi.

steps.q: ___ the high cost, the project was a success.
Which sentence is correct?
options: Despite it was cold, we swam.
Although it was cold, we swam.
Nevertheless it was cold, we swam.

steps.text: ___, the plan has some drawbacks. Nevertheless, it is worth trying.
answer: Admittedly
Granted
Of course
Undoubtedly
steps.uz: Tan olish kerakki, rejaning ba'zi kamchiliklari bor. Shunga qaramay, sinab ko'rishga arziydi.

steps.text: In my view, the benefits of tourism far ___ the disadvantages.
answer: outweigh
steps.uz: Menimcha, turizmning foydalari kamchiliklaridan ancha ustun.

steps.text: ___ it is true that cars are convenient, they are a major source of pollution.
answer: While
Although
Though
Whilst
steps.uz: Mashinalar qulay ekani rost bo'lsa-da, ular ifloslanishning asosiy manbai.

steps.q: Which is the best rebuttal?
options: This argument, however, overlooks the long-term savings.

steps.uz: Foydalar kamchiliklardan ancha ustun.
steps.answer: The benefits far outweigh the drawbacks

steps.q: What is the speaker's final opinion about homework?
steps.say: Admittedly, too much homework can cause stress. Even so, I believe a reasonable amount helps children develop independence and good study habits.
options: A reasonable amount of homework is useful.
steps.explain_uz: "Even so, I believe a reasonable amount helps..."

answer: Admittedly, this is a valid concern.
Admittedly this is a valid concern
Admittedly, this is a valid concern
steps.uz: Eshiting va yozing
Narxi baland bo'lishiga qaramay, ko'p odamlar elektromobil sotib olmoqda.
answer: Despite the high price many people are buying electric cars
Despite the high cost many people are buying electric cars
Despite the high price, many people are buying electric cars
In spite of the high price many people are buying electric cars
Although the price is high many people are buying electric cars

steps.text: While it is true that technology can be distracting, the benefits for education clearly outweigh the drawbacks.
steps.uz: Ovoz chiqarib ayting

steps.prompt_uz: Task 2 uchun bitta asosiy paragraf yozing (130+ so'z): "Some people think that children should not use smartphones until they are 14. To what extent do you agree?" Qarshi fikrni tan oling (Admittedly / While it is true that) va uni rad eting.
steps.prompt: Some people think that children should not be allowed to use smartphones until they are 14. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Write one body paragraph with a concession and a rebuttal.
steps.example: Those who support a ban argue that smartphones expose children to harmful content and reduce the time they spend playing outside. Admittedly, these are valid concerns, and there is compelling evidence that excessive screen time can affect sleep and concentration. Nevertheless, I would argue that a complete ban is neither realistic nor desirable. In today's world, smartphones are essential tools for communication and learning; a child without one may feel excluded from classmates and miss out on valuable educational apps. Moreover, a ban simply delays the problem: a fourteen-year-old who receives a phone with no prior guidance is arguably more vulnerable than a younger child who has learned to use it responsibly under parental supervision. While it is true that unlimited access is harmful, the solution lies in sensible limits and digital education rather than prohibition.

lessons.title: Speaking naturally: idioms
lessons.goal_uz: Speaking'da Lexical Resource ballini oshiradigan, tabiiy eshitiladigan idiomalarni o'rganasiz va ularni o'rinli ishlatishni bilib olasiz.

words.ex: The first part of the test was a piece of cake.
I eat fast food once in a blue moon.
I need to hit the books before my exam.
Driving was hard at first, but I got the hang of it.
Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
Let's make sure we're on the same page.
These problems are just the tip of the iceberg.
Good teachers always go the extra mile.

steps.title: Speaking Part 1 & 2: studies and work
steps.context_uz: Nomzod imtihonchiga o'qishi va birinchi ish tajribasi haqida gapirib beryapti.

lines.en: Do you find your studies easy?
Not exactly. Some subjects are a piece of cake, but statistics is a different story. Before exams I really have to hit the books.
lines.uz: Unchalik emas. Ba'zi fanlar juda oson, lekin statistika boshqa gap. Imtihon oldidan jiddiy o'qishga majbur bo'laman.

lines.en: Do you often go to the cinema?
Only once in a blue moon, to be honest. I usually watch films at home.
lines.uz: Rostini aytsam, juda kam. Odatda filmlarni uyda ko'raman.

lines.en: Tell me about your first job.

I worked in a call centre. At first it was overwhelming, but after a couple of weeks I got the hang of it. Actually, being rejected by my dream company the month before turned out to be a blessing in disguise, because my manager there went the extra mile to train me.
lines.uz: Men qo'ng'iroqlar markazida ishlaganman. Avvaliga juda og'ir edi, lekin bir-ikki haftadan keyin ko'nikib oldim. Aslida, bir oy oldin orzuimdagi kompaniya meni rad etgani yaxshilikka bo'ldi, chunki u yerdagi rahbarim meni o'rgatish uchun kutilganidan ham ko'proq harakat qildi.

steps.q: How often does the candidate go to the cinema?
steps.explain_uz: "once in a blue moon" = juda kam.

steps.q: Why was the rejection "a blessing in disguise"?
options: Because the candidate got more money
Because it led to a job with a very helpful manager
steps.explain_uz: Rad etilish yomon edi, lekin yaxshi rahbarli ishga olib keldi.

steps.body_uz:
IELTS Speaking'da **Lexical Resource** 7+ uchun "less common and idiomatic vocabulary" kerak — lekin **o'rinli** bo'lishi shart.
**1. Aniq shaklda ishlating**: idiomalar o'zgarmaydi. "a piece of **a** cake", "once in a **blue** moons" — xato!
**2. Faqat Speaking'da**: Writing Task 2 rasmiy — u yerda "a piece of cake" emas, **straightforward** yozing.
**3. Ko'p emas**: bitta javobda 1–2 ta yetarli. Har gapda idioma — sun'iy va ball pasayadi.
**4. Klişelardan qoching**: "It's raining cats and dogs" — imtihonchilar buni yodlangan deb biladi.
**5. Fe'lni zamon bo'yicha o'zgartiring**: I **got** the hang of it · She **went** the extra mile · I'**m hitting** the books.
Bog'lash uchun: **to be honest**, **as they say**, **actually** — idiomani tabiiy kiritadi.

examples.en: To be honest, the interview was a piece of cake.
examples.uz: Rostini aytsam, suhbat juda oson o'tdi.

examples.en: It took me a while, but I eventually got the hang of cooking.
examples.uz: Biroz vaqt oldi, lekin oxiri ovqat pishirishga ko'nikdim.

examples.en: Traffic jams are just the tip of the iceberg.
examples.uz: Tirbandlik — muammoning faqat ko'rinib turgan qismi.

examples.en: Before we start, let's make sure we're all on the same page.
examples.uz: Boshlashdan oldin, hammamiz bir fikrda ekanimizga ishonch hosil qilaylik.

steps.q: Which sentence uses the idiom correctly?
options: The exam was a piece of a cake.
The exam was a piece of cake.
The exam was piece of cakes.

steps.q: Where should you NOT use "a piece of cake"?

steps.text: I didn't understand chess at first, but now I've got the ___ of it.
answer: hang
steps.uz: Avval shaxmatni tushunmasdim, lekin endi ko'nikib oldim.

steps.text: I only visit my hometown once in a blue ___.
answer: moon
steps.uz: Ona shahrimga juda kam boraman.

steps.text: Our teacher always goes the extra ___ to help us.
answer: mile
steps.uz: O'qituvchimiz bizga yordam berish uchun doim kutilganidan ham ko'p harakat qiladi.

steps.q: "The problems you can see are just the tip of the iceberg." This means:
options: The problems are small and unimportant.
There are much bigger hidden problems.
steps.explain_uz: Ko'rinib turgani — kichik qism, asosiysi yashirin.

steps.uz: Imtihon oldidan jiddiy o'qishim kerak.
steps.answer: I need to hit the books before the exam

steps.q: How did the speaker feel about missing the flight in the end?
steps.say: Missing that flight was a blessing in disguise. I met my future business partner while I was waiting at the airport.
options: It turned out to be a good thing.
steps.explain_uz: "a blessing in disguise" — oxiri yaxshi bo'ldi.

answer: It was a blessing in disguise.
It was a blessing in disguise

Avvaliga qiyin edi, lekin tez orada ko'nikib oldim.
answer: It was difficult at first but I soon got the hang of it
It was hard at first but I soon got the hang of it

steps.text: To be honest, learning to drive wasn't a piece of cake, but I got the hang of it after a few weeks.
steps.uz: Ovoz chiqarib ayting

steps.prompt_uz: Speaking Part 2 uchun javob tayyorlang (120+ so'z): "Describe a skill that was difficult to learn." 3–4 ta idiomani o'rinli ishlating.
steps.prompt: Describe a skill that was difficult for you to learn. Say what it was, why you learned it, how you learned it, and how you feel about it now.
steps.example: I'd like to talk about learning to touch-type, which means typing without looking at the keyboard. I decided to learn it in my first year at university because I was spending hours typing essays with two fingers. Honestly, I assumed it would be a piece of cake, but the first two weeks were incredibly frustrating — I was actually slower than before. I used a free website and practised for fifteen minutes every evening, even when I didn't feel like it. After about a month, I finally got the hang of it. Looking back, the slow start was a blessing in disguise, because it forced me to build a daily habit. Now I can type about sixty words a minute, and it saves me so much time when I have to hit the books before deadlines.
